title: Smiling Blue Sun Entity
description: A large dark blue spherical being with glowing yellow crescent eyes and a wide golden smile dominates the center of a surreal desert scene. To its left are floating blue spheres and mechanical-organic structures with pipes and vegetation, while a stylized woman's profile with intricate patterns appears on the right against a cracked stone floor and distant mountains.
prompt: Surreal desert scene featuring a giant dark blue spherical creature with glowing yellow crescent eyes and a wide smiling mouth floating in the center. Floating blue spheres and biomechanical structures with pipes and palm-like plants occupy the left side. A stylized woman's profile with ornate golden patterns appears on the right. Cracked stone floor, distant mountains, warm golden sky, whimsical and mystical atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
